0022600125.text: The Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West, on a three-game win streak) host the Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East, on a one-game losing streak) in the Rockets' fourth game of the season. Houston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 121-114 win in Atlanta on October 24, and it also won both meetings in 2025-26 (2-0). Steven Adams is out for Houston with a calf strain, and Marcus Smart is day-to-day with a forearm strain and is a game-time decision, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture).
